Definition: Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol
BiblicalUsage: tᵉrâphîym stands behind the English phrase household idols, teraphim. In Genesis 31:19, Laban went to shear his sheep. Wherever it appears, the word means this and not something vaguer.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that household gods promise safety and deliver only bondage, and I will not keep idols in my own house. That is why I read the passages around tᵉrâphîym slowly, instead of hurrying past.
